First, we distribute the $3$ over each of the terms in parentheses.

$$
\eqalign{
		(4+c)\cdot 3-8 &= \[5pt]
		4\cdot3+c\cdot 3-8 &= \[5pt]
		(12)+(3c)-8 &= \[5pt]
		12+3c-8 &
	}
$$

Then, we collect like terms.

$$
\eqalign{
		12+3c-8 &= \[5pt]
		3c +(12-8)&= \[5pt]
		3c+4
	}
$$
